business_problem: Sphere needed a cost-effective but enterprise-grade data platform for its OrgBrain AI offering that could handle massive mixed-format data sets, support AI retrieval and generation, and satisfy stringent customer security and data residency requirements without forcing a small startup team to stitch together multiple specialty databases.
solution_summary: Sphere built its OrgBrain platform on Oracle Database running in Oracle Autonomous Database so one converged system could store and query relational, vector, spatial, JSON, and graph data without the operational burden of separate engines. Enterprise knowledge sources and diverse file types are centralized in Autonomous Database, where Oracle AI Vector Search and native large language model integration power retrieval across documents, audio, video, and structured records. Oracle REST Data Services exposes the database model to applications quickly, while Oracle JSON Relational Duality Views lets developers work with JSON representations backed by relational storage. The result is a secure, scalable AI platform with one data-layer security architecture that can support regulated enterprise workflows such as grant proposal drafting and compliance-oriented decision support.

solution_components.name: Oracle Database
solution_components.role: Provides the core database engine behind OrgBrain's converged data model for enterprise knowledge and workflow content.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous Database
solution_components.role: Runs the platform's centralized, self-managing repository for relational, vector, spatial, JSON, and graph data with enterprise security controls.

solution_components.name: Oracle AI Vector Search
solution_components.role: Executes semantic retrieval over vectorized enterprise content to support fast AI-assisted search and drafting workflows.

solution_components.name: Oracle REST Data Services
solution_components.role: Maps OrgBrain data models into application objects and APIs, accelerating delivery for the small development team.

solution_components.name: Oracle JSON Relational Duality Views
solution_components.role: Lets developers work with JSON-style objects while keeping data stored efficiently in relational structures.

data_flow: Enterprise documents, audio, video, and other knowledge sources are stored together in Oracle Autonomous Database; Oracle AI Vector Search and integrated LLM capabilities retrieve and rank relevant content; Oracle REST Data Services and JSON Relational Duality Views expose the results to OrgBrain applications that generate outputs such as evidence-based grant proposal drafts and governance workflows.
business_outcome: Sphere launched an enterprise AI platform without assembling multiple specialized databases, kept a lean development model, and sped regulated customer workflows such as grant proposal drafting from as long as one to two weeks to about five minutes while maintaining strong security and data residency controls.
